name: Echo Orchard
description: An abandoned orchard repeats sounds with a delay of several minutes.

scenes.name: Belated Birds
scenes.description: Birdsong can be heard after the flock has already vanished beyond the horizon.

scenes.name: Answering Well
scenes.description: The well returns not the words spoken to it, but someone's quiet reply.

scenes.name: Glass Apples
scenes.description: Transparent apples grow on one tree, ringing with every gust of wind.
